issues.description: The problem statement explicitly requires calculateTotalPrice to be static (shared across all SealSaloon instances), but the provided solution implements calculateTotalPrice as an instance method. Additionally, the provided Main code calls calculateTotalPrice as an instance method on a SealSaloon object, which contradicts the 'must be static' requirement in the specification. This inconsistency can confuse students about whether calculateTotalPrice should be declared static or instance-level.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the specification and code consistent. Either: (A) Update the problem statement to allow calculateTotalPrice to be an instance method (and remove the 'must be static' requirement), or (B) change the solution and example Main usage so calculateTotalPrice is declared static (e.g., public static int calculateTotalPrice(Meal)) and update calls accordingly (SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice(meal)). Ensure the chosen approach is documented in the problem text so students know whether to implement calculateTotalPrice as static or instance-level.
